title: Find the Longest Increasing Run
question: Find the length of the longest strictly increasing contiguous run.
code:
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
best = current = 0
previous = None
for number in nums:
    current = current + 1 if previous is not None and number > previous else 1
    best = max(best, current)
    previous = number
print(best)
explanation: Reset the run whenever the next value is not larger.
